findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_multi_page_surface, make_surface_url, preview_url, render_surface, make_film, render_ping, diagram_studio, amiga, publish_url, emit_runbook_surface, open_workspace, read_article, drawio_open · Private data: diagram_studio, distill_document, emit_deployment, save_reading, export_reading, render_reading_to_slack, deck_build, drawio_open · Public sink: make_surface_url, publish_url, open_workspace, render_reading_to_slack, unlink_slack_account · Destructive: make_surface_url, make_film, unpublish_url, emit_deployment, open_workspace, export_reading, delete_reading, drawio_open.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_multi_page_surface, make_surface_url, preview_url, render_surface, make_film, render_ping, diagram_studio, amiga, publish_url, emit_runbook_surface, open_workspace, read_article, drawio_open · Private data: diagram_studio, distill_document, emit_deployment, save_reading, export_reading, render_reading_to_slack, deck_build, drawio_open · Public sink: make_surface_url, publish_url, open_workspace, render_reading_to_slack, unlink_slack_account · Destructive: make_surface_url, make_film, unpublish_url, emit_deployment, open_workspace, export_reading, delete_reading, drawio_open

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
